# Psychedelics Knowledge Graph

> A living map of psychedelic research with links from structured findings back to their source reports, available to people, applications, and AI agents.

The public API provides a curated catalogue of papers, concepts,
OpenAlex/ORCID-backed authors, and deduplicated paper-level relationships. It intentionally does
not expose granular findings, statistics, quotes, or internal curation data.
Record the data version ID when using API results.

## Agent and data access

- [Agent access guide](https://psychedelicskg.com/api/agent-guide.md): Concise machine-readable instructions, endpoints, available tools, and interpretation guidance.
- [API guide](https://psychedelicskg.com/api/): REST, MCP, and download documentation.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable REST contract.
- [Interactive API reference](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/docs): Browser-based endpoint documentation.
- [MCP server](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/mcp): Public read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint for remote clients.
- [Data version and counts](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/api/v1/meta): Version ID, public scope, and record counts.
- [Database structure](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/api/v1/schema): Documented tables, fields, keys, and limitations.

## Human-facing project documentation

- [Interactive graph](https://psychedelicskg.com/): Navigate evidence by compound, research area, and standardized concept.
- [About](https://psychedelicskg.com/about/): Purpose and intended use of the project.
- [Methods](https://psychedelicskg.com/methods/): Literature discovery, screening, extraction, validation, and updating methods.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/povilaskarvelis/psychedelics_knowledge_graph): Open-source pipeline and technical documentation.

## Optional

- [Feedback](https://psychedelicskg.com/feedback/): Report missing evidence, errors, access problems, or suggestions privately.
